method: Adds machine-readable per-component decision_owner, reason and normative_ref for every EXPLICITLY_REJECTED or DECLARED_LOSS component recorded in AllLinesS2cClosure.amendment.v1.json. The addendum is additive evidence; no disposition, row, source file, frozen member, production code or authority ceiling was changed.
scope: S2c component decisions in AllLinesS2cClosure.amendment.v1.json only: 12 EXPLICITLY_REJECTED entries and 2 DECLARED_LOSS entries across ALL-SM-003/004/005/006/008/014/016/017/018 and ALL-GAP-001/002.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW search/discovery worker lane owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: The untracked DashboardSearchRetrievalRunPanel.tsx donor UI is absent from the target successor scope and clean source track; the line realizes only the typed read-only retrieval panel contract. The untracked UI bytes are a bounded intentional loss, not a reconstructed panel.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW search/discovery worker lane owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Search index writes are canonical/provider mutation effects outside the S2c read-only retrieval projection; the successor surface keeps index/search/provider/canonical-write authority false and dispatch count zero.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW source-library/resource lane owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Provider dispatch is an external runtime effect and guard-boundary execution is not part of the readback/matrix projection; the successor surface keeps provider dispatch count zero and never executes the guard boundary.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW project/config workflow owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Project/config/env CRUD and customization workflow execution are canonical write or executor effects; only the typed read-only project/config surface was implemented with all mutation authority flags false.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW dashboard/admin/governance owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Report synthesis from dashboard filters would require canonical report generation or durable admission effects; the row realizes dashboard readback only and carries no report/write/export authority.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW dashboard/admin/governance owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Admin/governance cleanup, aggregator sync and related mutations are canonical write or executor effects; the S2c dashboard/admin surface records explicit no-call decisions instead of reconstructing mutation authority.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW runtime ops owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Retry, cancel, service-start and probe execution are executor/scheduler effects; the typed runtime-ops surface defaults control actions to never-execute and exposes runtime readback only.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW dashboard/report owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Durable export-audit write requires canonical database write authority; the successor surface only consumes already-available export-audit evidence and records the write as an explicit no-call.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW report trend owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Durable report-trend aggregation is a database mutation; the successor surface consumes trend evidence, marks degraded readback and never performs durable aggregation.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW runtime ops owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Health probe execution is an executor/network/service-start effect; the health-matrix surface classifies status passively and never runs probes or writes artifacts.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW admin/ops owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Skills invocation executes external agents/tools and would cross credential and execution boundaries; codex-auth handling stays structural with credential_read false and no invocation call.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW admin/ops owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: Project customization execution is not reproduced because no successor mutation/execution cell was authorized for this line; the per-group ops-misc surface records it as an explicit, reviewed loss rather than a silent no-call.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW agent-batch owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: A separate quality-promotion surface would duplicate the existing ALL-SM-013 readback/quality-promotion port; the supplementary gap is folded into that existing binding instead of creating a new authority surface.

component_decision_reasons.decision_owner: MRW runtime ops owner (B-recheck); S2c decision owner
component_decision_reasons.reason: A separate runtime-health surface would duplicate the ALL-SM-008/ALL-SM-017 health-matrix lane; the supplementary gap is folded into that shared lane without adding a new authority surface.

risks: This addendum adds decision reasons only; row-level REIMPLEMENTED_AS labels still do not claim reconstruction of rejected provider/mutation/durable-write components.
The referenced frozen scope and LegacyVsMovementGap bytes are historical states; current-state closure authority remains local-only with no promotion, candidate, cutover or live-provider claim.
